question: If this project started today, would we still build this?

subsystems.problem_solved: Separate provider/runtime-specific invocation and read-only transport from portable workforce and task policy.
subsystems.property_bought: Provider-neutral core plus explicit runtime edge boundaries for read-only observation and bounded execution.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces Hermes lock-in and prevents provider-specific invocation semantics from leaking into portable governance.
failure_modes: False portability inference from conformance-only tests
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — the project still needs an explicit runtime boundary even if implemented today.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Keep boundaries explicit until canonical live portability evidence exists; do not collapse adapters merely to reduce file count.

subsystems.problem_solved: Provide a disposable, same-contract path for comparing multiple installed agent harnesses without auto-install/login.
subsystems.property_bought: A repeatable route toward cross-harness behavioral evidence using identical protected atoms and temporary workspaces.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces hand-wavy parity claims and limits benchmark mutation of user workspaces.
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — it is the explicit collection mechanism for a still-open cross-harness proof debt.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Do not delete while live parity remains an explicit unproven claim; deleting it would remove the supported path to collect that evidence.

subsystems.problem_solved: Report provider install/config/readiness state without provider calls, login, or credential disclosure.
subsystems.property_bought: Side-effect-free readiness diagnostics with explicit configured-versus-executed truth boundaries.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces unsafe auto-install/login behavior and prevents environment detection from being mislabeled as execution.
failure_modes: False readiness from weak environment signals
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — user-owned provider setup needs a safe diagnostic boundary even if rebuilt today.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Keep, but never use doctor output alone as behavioral evidence; Chat 17 enforces this.

subsystems.problem_solved: Verify evidence packets/receipts and independently compare verdict semantics across Node and Python.
subsystems.property_bought: Tamper-aware evidence verification plus cross-implementation consistency testing.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces single-implementation bugs and false VERIFIED states from malformed evidence.
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — independent verification is a core trust property, not presentation machinery.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Large byte surface is mostly corpus/reference implementation; retain because it buys cross-implementation evidence that cannot be replaced by self-tests.

subsystems.problem_solved: Bind task, worker, capability, result/evidence metadata, signing identity, and provenance into tamper-evident receipts.
subsystems.property_bought: Cryptographic authenticity/integrity of execution records with explicit claim limits.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces silent receipt tampering and ambiguous task/worker/capability attribution.
failure_modes: Receipt authenticity confused with external-world correctness
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — provenance/authenticity remains necessary even with a different runtime architecture.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Keep with the existing truth boundary: a valid signature never substitutes for independent external correctness.

subsystems.problem_solved: Define what may enter per-worker/shared learning and test deterministic cross-profile isolation.
subsystems.property_bought: Bounded memory promotion plus protection against accidental worker-to-worker state leakage.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces unsafe long-lived memory contamination, secret promotion, and personality/context leakage.
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — multi-worker memory without explicit isolation would weaken the product's trust model.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Keep policy portable; provider-specific memory lifecycle stays separate and is still only partial/unproven.

subsystems.problem_solved: Package one/subset/preset/full worker distributions reproducibly with exact skill/integration closure.
subsystems.property_bought: Selective installability and reproducible employee artifacts instead of all-or-nothing deployment.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces accidental over-installation and distribution drift between workforce definitions and shipped packs.
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — selective workforce installation is a deliberate user-facing distribution property.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Keep; generated duplication is accepted only where byte/reproducibility checks bind it to canonical sources.

subsystems.problem_solved: Exercise one-worker, subset, full, upgrade, uninstall, and reinstall semantics in isolated profile homes.
subsystems.property_bought: Deterministic regression coverage for selection, idempotency, user-state preservation, removal safety, and byte integrity.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces destructive installer regressions before real clean-machine testing.
failure_modes: Simulation diverges from real Hermes environment
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — destructive lifecycle behavior warrants deterministic pre-release regression coverage.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Keep but preserve its SELF_OBSERVATION classification; it does not replace the deferred clean-machine lifecycle.

subsystems.problem_solved: Capture direct non-generated owner work with append-only/hash-linked evidence and preserve failures for baseline collection.
subsystems.property_bought: A truth-preserving path from real work to an independently reviewable dataset.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces synthetic benchmark laundering, cherry-picking, and false-success reporting.
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — real-world evidence cannot be substituted by generated fixtures or repository self-observation.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Keep; current 1/20 failure is evidence of the recorder preserving truth rather than a reason to remove it.

subsystems.problem_solved: Preserve historical v0.4 accepted-deferral truth while producing compact release claim snapshots.
subsystems.property_bought: Machine-readable separation between release-scope acceptance and actual evidence completion.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces retroactive rewriting of UNPROVEN/NOT_RUN/COLLECTING states when a release is authorized.
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES to the behavior, NO to two top-level package boundaries — the historical validator/snapshot can live under release-claims.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Merge package boundaries in Chat 19 only after dependency scan stays bounded. Preserve config/v0.4-deferred-evidence.json and historical docs unchanged.

subsystems.problem_solved: Gate high-impact work on owner approval and surface anomalies/missing evidence before descriptive agent prose.
subsystems.property_bought: Human authority over risky actions with structured anomaly-first oversight.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces self-approval, hidden anomalies, and approval decisions based solely on agent-authored summaries.
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — human authority is a core product constraint, not optional UI polish.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Keep. Chat 16 reduced review burden without weakening the owner gate.

subsystems.problem_solved: Reconcile imported/local runtime-looking claims against authoritative read-only runtime snapshots.
subsystems.property_bought: Explicit LOCAL_CLAIM vs AUTHORITATIVE_RUNTIME provenance with quarantine on mismatch.
subsystems.risk_reduced: Reduces fabricated/stale runtime state being displayed as authoritative execution.
subsystems.delete_test_answer: YES — without reconciliation the UI would collapse claim and runtime truth into one unsafe state.
subsystems.owner_review_note: Keep fail-closed and read-only; runtime write/dispatch remains out of this boundary.

deep_evaluations.concrete_change: Move v0.4 deferred-ledger validation/snapshot code and its tests under packages/release-claims/, update internal imports, then remove the separate packages/deferred-evidence/ boundary.
planned_changes: Relocate deferred validator/snapshot module under release-claims
Fold test:deferred-evidence into release-claims test surface
Delete only the obsolete top-level deferred-evidence package directory
risks: Accidentally changing v0.4 historical decision semantics
replacement_test_plan: Exact dependency scan must match expected importers before prune
All deferred-evidence negative tests must pass from new location
Release-claims tests must preserve snapshot values
Release manifest must still report the same deferred decision/open-blocker counts
deep_evaluations.migration_note: Internal-only module move: the repository root package is private and has no package exports. Historical JSON/docs remain at their existing paths.
deep_evaluations.rollback_recovery: Revert the Chat 19 pruning commit; the historical JSON ledger and docs are not moved or rewritten.
